page.title: Catalyst Monitor
page.subtitle: Clinical event watchlist, catalyst calendar and event timeline

guide.title: How to use this page (start here if new to biotech investing)
guide.whyBody: Biotech stock prices hinge on a few key dates: clinical data readouts, FDA decisions. These events are binary — +50% or cut in half in a day — and the market often moves before the announcement. This page does three things: counts down to events so you prepare a plan; pushes alerts with AI interpretation and a trade rating the moment things happen; and lets you check afterwards whether the price moved early.
guide.watchlistBody: Add companies you hold or follow — no need to pick trials manually: auto-discovery (on by default) adds the company's lead-sponsored active trials every 12h and pushes when new ones are registered. You can still hand-pick via "Search Clinical Trials". Keywords should be drug codes (e.g. ABCL635) for news matching. Strongly recommend filling the scenario plan: pre-write what you'll do if data is good/mixed/bad, and the AI will map results to a tier when the event lands.
guide.glossaryBody:
· NCT ID: a trial's ID in the official registry — handled automatically
· Phase 1: dozens of people, safety
· Phase 2: hundreds, first efficacy test — make-or-break for most biotechs
· Phase 3: confirmatory trial deciding approval
· Topline data: first release of main results — the biggest price mover
· Primary completion: data collection ends; publication follows weeks to months later
· PDUFA date: FDA's decision deadline
· 8-K: mandatory material-event filing
· T1 halt: trading paused for "news pending" — often right before a readout
guide.timelineBody: Everything the system captured. Gray "Archived" is the initial background snapshot — ignore it; amber "Updated" is a real change — read it. Each event carries AI analysis and a colored trade rating. The Attribution button replays whether the price moved before the announcement.
guide.calendarBody: Countdowns to dates that can move the stock. The Custom Catalysts section matters most — add dates manually, and the AI extracts company-guided dates from filings; the trial-registry dates below are rough references. Reminders push at T-7 and T-1.
guide.marketBody: Every 2 minutes during market hours, checks whether your stocks move abnormally (beyond their own history, on heavy volume, not sector-wide). On trigger, your phone rings with an AI briefing — and if there's no public news matching the move, it warns about possible undisclosed information: the real-time catch for "the price moved early".

manager.title: Watch List
manager.hint: Add a company and tick the trials to follow; the daemon monitors its filings, halts and trial status changes
manager.empty: No entries yet. Click "Add Company" to start.
manager.stockSearchPlaceholder: Type a ticker or company name, then pick from the dropdown
manager.trialsHint: Optional — with auto-discovery below, the company's active trials are tracked automatically
manager.autoDiscover: Auto-discover trials: every 12h, query the registry by company and add its lead-sponsored active trials (Phase 2/3 first, up to 10). New registrations trigger a push. Manually picked trials are always kept.
manager.noTrials: No trials found. Try adjusting the company name.
manager.deleteConfirm: Remove {symbol}? Historical events are kept, but it will no longer be monitored.
manager.scenariosPlaceholder:
Pre-set success/mixed/failure criteria, e.g.:
Success: primary endpoint p<0.05, no grade ≥3 safety events → add
Mixed: met but weak effect size or subgroup-driven → hold
Failure: missed endpoint or safety red flag → exit
The AI will map results to a scenario when data drops
